description: Adaptics is an open innovation hackathon organized by MnM (Technology Partner- Adaption Labs, .cv, .xyz) , bringing together individuals who are passionate about technology, the hackathon encourages participants to explore challenges across diverse domains, including healthcare for the elderly, agricultural supply chain management, global carbon emission reduction, and the application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development and economic empowerment . Participants are also free to identify problems beyond these suggested domains and propose their own innovative solutions. For all updates join Whatsapp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/FcImRJZMxITKreWgKMjxNn Adaptics is structured into three competitive rounds: Round 1 – Idea Presentation: Participants submit a PowerPoint presentation outlining the problem they aim to solve, their proposed solution, its innovation and potential impact. Round 2 – Prototype Development & Showcase: Shortlisted participants develop a working prototype of their proposed solution and showcase their progress through a LinkedIn post. Finale – Jury Evaluation: The top shortlisted participants present their solutions before a jury panel for final evaluation. Event Duration: 9 December 2026, 12:00 AM – 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Adaptics is more than a competition. It is an opportunity to turn ideas into working solutions, challenge conventional thinking and demonstrate how individual innovation can address problems that matter. Think independently. Build relentlessly. Create impact. ADAPTICS

raw.details:
Adaptics is an open innovation hackathon organized by MnM (Technology Partner- Adaption Labs, .cv, .xyz), bringing together individuals who are passionate about technology, the hackathon encourages participants to explore challenges across diverse domains, including healthcare for the elderly, agricultural supply chain management, global carbon emission reduction, and the application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development and economic empowerment. Participants are also free to identify problems beyond these suggested domains and propose their own innovative solutions.

For all updates join Whatsapp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/FcImRJZMxITKreWgKMjxNn 

Adaptics is structured into three competitive rounds:

  • Round 1 – Idea Presentation: Participants submit a PowerPoint presentation outlining the problem they aim to solve, their proposed solution, its innovation and potential impact.
  • Round 2 – Prototype Development & Showcase: Shortlisted participants develop a working prototype of their proposed solution and showcase their progress through a LinkedIn post.
  • Finale – Jury Evaluation: The top shortlisted participants present their solutions before a jury panel for final evaluation.

Event Duration: 9 December 2026, 12:00 AM – 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM.

Adaptics is more than a competition. It is an opportunity to turn ideas into working solutions, challenge conventional thinking and demonstrate how individual innovation can address problems that matter.

Think independently. Build relentlessly. Create impact.

 ADAPTICS
